question: The price of kerosene increases by 10% every year. If the current price of kerosene is ₹50 per litre, then what will be the price of kerosene per litre after 2 years?
solution:
Given:

The price of kerosene increases by 10% every year. 

The current price of kerosene is ₹50 per litre.

Concept used:

In case of the compound interest,

Amount = P(1 + R/100)N

CI = P(1 + R/100)<s
